grammar.label: a lot of / lots of / much / many / a little / a few
grammar.form: much + uncountable; many + countable; a lot of + both

explanation.en: Many counts (many books); much does not (much water). A lot of works with both.
explanation.uz: many — sanaladiganlar bilan (many books); much — sanalmaydiganlar bilan (much water). a lot of — ikkalasi bilan.

grammar.positive_example: There isn't much time, but there are a lot of people.

l1_notes.uz: much/many farqi o'zbekchada yo'q ('ko'p' hamma joyda) — sanaladimi yoki yo'qmi, avval shuni aniqlang.

grammar.label: How much…? / How many…?
grammar.form: How much + uncountable; How many + countable

explanation.en: How many for things you can count; how much for things you cannot — and for prices.
explanation.uz: How many — sanaladiganlar uchun; how much — sanalmaydiganlar va narx uchun.

grammar.positive_example: How much is this? How many brothers do you have?

grammar.label: one / ones
grammar.form: one (singular), ones (plural) replacing a known noun

explanation.en: Use one or ones instead of repeating the noun: I'll take the red one.
explanation.uz: Otni takrorlamaslik uchun: I'll take the red one.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada sifat o'zi yetarli ('ko'kini'); ingliz tilida 'one' qo'shiladi.
